<?php
class Store {
    public $bufferBank;private $records, $listeners = [], $serial = 0, $revision = 0;
    function __construct($records) { $this->records = $records; }
    function read($id) { return $this->records[$id] ?? ''; }
    function subscribe($fn) { $token = ++$this->serial; $this->listeners[$token] = $fn; return $token; }
    function stop($token) { unset($this->listeners[$token]); }
    function write($id, $text) {
        $this->records[$id] = $text;
        $event = ['id'=>$id, 'text'=>$text, 'revision'=>++$this->revision];
        foreach ($this->listeners as $token=>$fn) if (isset($this->listeners[$token])) $fn($event);
        return $event;
    }
}
class Trailing {
    private $env, $delay, $work, $handle = null, $pending = null;
    function __construct($env, $delay, $work) { $this->env=$env; $this->delay=$delay; $this->work=$work; }
    function push($value) {
        if ($this->handle !== null) $this->env->cancel($this->handle);
        $this->pending=$value;
        $this->handle=$this->env->schedule(function() { $this->flush(); }, $this->delay);
    }
    function flush() {
        if ($this->handle !== null) $this->env->cancel($this->handle);
        $value=$this->pending; $this->pending=null; $this->handle=null;
        if ($value !== null) ($this->work)($value);
    }
    function cancel() {
        if ($this->handle !== null) $this->env->cancel($this->handle);
        $this->pending=null; $this->handle=null;
    }
}

class Badge {public $id,$buffer;private $env,$token;function __construct($env,$id,$buffer){$this->env=$env;$this->id=$id;$this->buffer=$buffer;$this->token=$env->store->subscribe(function($e)use($env,$id){if($e['id']===$id)$env->output('status',$e);});}function detach(){$this->env->store->stop($this->token);}}
class BufferBank {public $entries=[];function get($env,$id){if(!isset($this->entries[$id]))$this->entries[$id]=new Trailing($env,120,function($text)use($env,$id){$env->write($id,$text);});return $this->entries[$id];}}
class Workspace {private $env,$current=null,$generation=0;private $bank;function __construct($env){$this->env=$env;if(!$env->store->bufferBank)$env->store->bufferBank=new BufferBank();$this->bank=$env->store->bufferBank;}
 private function retire(){$old=$this->current;$this->current=null;if($old)$old->detach();$this->env->output('document',null);if($old)$old->buffer->flush();}
 function open($id){$request=++$this->generation;$this->retire();if($request!==$this->generation)return;$buffer=$this->bank->get($this->env,$id);$this->current=new Badge($this->env,$id,$buffer);$this->env->output('document',['id'=>$id,'text'=>$this->env->store->read($id)]);}
 function edit($text){$view=$this->current;if($view){$view->buffer->push($text);}}function close(){++$this->generation;$this->retire();}function dispose(){$this->close();}
}
class Preview {private $task;function __construct($env){$this->task=new Trailing($env,40,function($q)use($env){$env->output('preview',['query'=>$q]);});}function query($text){$this->task->push($text);}function hide(){$this->task->cancel();}}

lifecycle_identity: Each queued edit belongs to the document ID and store-owned BufferBank entry captured from the current Badge when edit(text) is called.
BufferBank entries persist independently of Badge lifetime and are reused for the same document ID.
A Badge owns only its live store subscription; detaching the Badge must not destroy its document buffer.
The Workspace generation identifies the currently authoritative open/close request; a request superseded during callback-capable retirement must not install a view.

obligations.text: When edit(text) is called with a current Badge, enqueue that text into the Badge's per-document Trailing buffer instead of writing it immediately; with no current Badge, preserve the no-op behavior.
Use a 120 ms trailing quiet interval: each new edit in the same burst replaces the pending text and resets the timer, and the buffer writes only the latest text after 120 ms without another edit.

After consuming one burst, retire its pending value and timer state before invoking the write callback so later bursts, including edits caused synchronously during saving, can establish independent pending work and save normally.
Treat the empty string as valid pending text; only null denotes absence of pending work.
Keep buffers store-owned and keyed by document ID, so pending work remains associated with its original document across Badge retirement and buffer reuse.

On open, close, or dispose, preserve accepted edits and the editor's existing persistence/navigation behavior. If pending work is flushed at departure to preserve synchronous availability, first revoke the departing Badge's current ownership and detach its subscription, then perform the save through its captured buffer.

Because saving synchronously notifies listeners that may navigate, retain the existing generation check after retirement and before installing an opened document; a superseded outer request must produce no later document installation.
Preserve Store write ordering and payload behavior: update the record, increment revision, and synchronously notify still-subscribed listeners with the original id and text.
Preserve all public interfaces and leave the adjacent Preview implementation unchanged, including its separate 40 ms interval and hide cancellation.

ordering_barriers: At edit acceptance, resolve the current Badge and its buffer before deferring the save; document selection must not be deferred until timer consumption.
Within Trailing.push, cancel the prior handle before replacing pending text and scheduling the new 120 ms handle.
Within Trailing.flush, capture the pending value and clear pending/handle state before calling callback-capable write work.
During Badge retirement, set Workspace current to null and detach the captured Badge before any pending-buffer save can synchronously notify listeners and navigate.
In open(id), increment and capture generation before retirement, then recheck that generation after retirement and before obtaining/installing the destination Badge.
Do not publish a stale outer document after a synchronous nested open or close has changed generation.
preservation: Workspace continues to expose open(id), edit(text), close(), and dispose(); Preview continues to expose query(text) and hide().

Document reads, writes, IDs, text, revisions, synchronous listener notification, and current-document status filtering retain their existing semantics except for the task-required edit coalescing delay.
Opening still clears the departing document, detaches its Badge, reads the selected document, subscribes a new Badge, and outputs the document when the request remains authoritative.
Closing and disposing still retire the current Badge and clear document output.
Per-document buffers remain independent and reusable through the Store's BufferBank.
Preview remains a separate transient trailing task with a 40 ms interval, and hide continues to cancel it.
